outcome: Neonatal total thyroxine (TT4) levels in newborn screening
cohort: The study included 101,450 mother-infant dyads from singleton, term liveborn pregnancies.
finding: Maternal GDM was not associated with clinically significant differences in newborn screening total thyroxine (TT4) levels, despite GDM pregnancies showing increased risks of adverse maternal-neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: GDM pregnancies had higher odds of Cesarean delivery, and Cesarean delivery was identified as a factor associated with neonatal TT4 levels.
